cost_audit.audit_method: Read-only aggregation of existing final supervisor, original response, shared-budget, world, preparation, common-restore and guard receipts; no model call, GPU diagnostic, rerun or reacceptance was performed.

timing.scope: Supervisor measured worker lifetime on each recorded physical GPU, including loading, restore, CPU preparation, evaluation guard and close/poll overhead; not pure GPU kernel time. Parallel workers are summed. CPU sub-times are nested, not added again.

interpretation: All 32 final admission rejections are checked individually in stopping_rejections; use context_capacity rather than translating the inherited model_budget_exhausted role label as exhaustion of the 500000-token episode pool.
Rejected reservations consume decision opportunities but generation never starts; these 32 requests produce no output and are not included in actual model calls or tokens.
The fixed context limit is 16384 and the reserved output limit remains 2048. Each rejected selected prompt plus reserved output is compared against both context capacity and available shared tokens.

Four independent worker processes each executed the two initial diagnostic drivers once. Twelve subsequent conditions reused those exact receipts with zero additional driver executions. Environment preparation has zero model calls and zero actor run_tests charges.
No fixed delivery was submitted; no additional private acceptance was executed. This file does not evaluate final mutable working copies.
All observed workers used physical GPUs 3,4,5,7. No extra worker or slot was created by this audit.

interpretation: The frozen work-use files give false for all 16 episodes, with no program chains, semantic candidates, unsupported relations or measurement gaps. This is a bounded observation of absent cross-member chains, not a general claim that collaboration is useless.

There were no actual message sends, fixed patch publications, integrations, task events, births or submissions. Hence received-message inputs and evidenced cross-member use are also absent; nothing is credited merely for delivery or task IDs.

All initial diagnostic reports were environment preparation. The 48 distinct assigned member/report pairs were observed in actual charged inputs. Repeated selected-history copies are not counted as fresh facts.

Seventeen real member public tests ran; the 16 split-condition tests produced both groups, including a group not initially assigned to each caller. Existing frozen work-use records contain zero own-test-result reports in a later actual selected model input. Execution alone is not credited as knowledge reacquisition or use.

Each of 32 initial members stopped on a pre-generation context-capacity rejection: prompt plus reserved 2048 output exceeded 16384. These 32 decisions generated no model output. Team attempt/token pools were not exhausted. Six shared episodes had only one actual model call per member.

The new unknown-name rejection hook and explicit forbidden-action branch were not triggered in these episodes. All 11 other format errors were the existing exactly-one-native-tool-call/no-tool-text boundary; three separate world replace_file requests were rejected. No names were rewritten or retried for free.
Two workspace public tests passed, but no fixed submission exists. Public workspace quality is not the formal fixed-delivery R or independent acceptance.

The difference in input arrangement also changes context occupancy and available opportunities. All formal R values are zero; these finite observations cannot establish equality of underlying cooperation or isolate a semantic information effect from context-capacity effects.

startup_context_review.scope: Read existing JSON and frozen selection code only. No tokenizer/model/GPU, no generation or retry, no source/queue/episode mutation. Original 16 frozen episodes continue. Only this review file is newly written.
findings: ST admission failures were per-request context capacity failures, not exhaustion of the 500000-token shared pool: 14365+2048=16413 and 14360+2048=16408 exceeded context 16384 by 29 and 24 tokens.

ST retained first and latest full observation messages plus its only complete assistant/tool round. The round was the newest one and was protected by the frozen capacity selector; there were no older complete rounds available to remove.

Both retained ST observations included equal initial_diagnostics values. Each value serialized to 4880 UTF-8 bytes/characters with the same JSON formatting used in the observation. This is observed duplicate text, not a measured isolated token count. The same 2819-character role_task was present in each observation.

Frozen v034 deduplication removes exact repeated contract/root_goal descriptions, but does not deduplicate initial_diagnostics, role_task or other fields. Rebuilding only the stored request envelope and running this pure JSON deduplication exactly matched both recorded selected_request hashes; no retokenization was performed.

SB comparison also closed R0 during this review: 11 actual generation attempts and 13 decisions; both members eventually hit context capacity. This is an observation from a different seed/framing condition, not a controlled estimate of the effect of team framing or diagnostic repetition.
causal_limits: The immediate rejection mechanism and exact capacity margin are directly recorded measurements. Repeated initial diagnostics occupy protected prompt content and are a plausible substantial contributor to prompt growth.

No tokenizer or counterfactual request was evaluated. The isolated token cost of diagnostics, and whether deleting/deduplicating them alone would admit a request, were not measured; no causal effect size or assured counterfactual success is claimed.
First-to-second-call growth includes the retained extra observation, repeated task/policy/budget fields and a real assistant/tool exchange. It cannot be assigned wholly to diagnostic reports.
Early R0 reflects the frozen run with no fixed submission. It must not be interpreted as evidence that a longer-context implementation would fail, or as evidence of organizational benefit/harm.

primary_slot.rejection_archive_note: raw-transport contains only two actual calls. Admission rejection happens before transport.complete writes a request directory; exact measured preparation and rejection evidence are retained in team-budget.json and experience.jsonl sequences 46/48 and 55/57. Original semantic messages are retained in SDK events. Derived request envelopes were used only in memory to verify recorded hashes, not substituted into the run.

resource_authorization.reason: All four declared root/seed blocks already had GPUs; no extra inventory, process migration or resampling was introduced.

interpretation: The fixed 16-slot inventory completed without technical unknowns; all business R are zero because no fixed delivery was submitted.
Every member stopped at per-request context capacity while the shared episode token budget still had room.
No cross-member use chain was observed. This does not establish unwillingness or inability to cooperate under usable execution conditions.

Identical diagnostic text and role instructions are retained in first/latest observations in the inspected ST request; isolated token savings and a corrected-presentation outcome have not been measured.
The new unknown-name policy passed finite CPU controls but was not triggered by the real 16 episodes.
No new-model selection, precision/context change, automatic submission, old-slot repair, sample extension or parameter learning occurred.
